question: If the first insured (William Hartford) dies after this policy has been in force for 5 years, will the death benefit be paid to beneficiaries at that time?
expected_answer: No. No death benefit is paid on the first death. The policy continues in force until the second insured also dies, at which point the $2,500,000 is paid.
evidence: 1.2 DEATH BENEFIT TRIGGER: The death benefit is payable only upon the death of the SECOND insured to die (survivorship basis). / 1.3 If the first insured dies, no death benefit is paid and the policy continues in force covering the surviving insured.
